item.title: Get clean clothes before a trip
item.context_text: You need to wash and dry clothes today. You have a bank card and no coins.
item.objective_text: Choose machines you can pay for and explain your plan.
success_conditions: Choose machines you can pay for and explain your plan.

children.title: Read the signs by the machines
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Washers one to three take only coins. Washer four takes cards. Each wash takes thirty minutes. All dryers take cards. A dry takes twenty minutes.

questions.explanation: The sign gives a twenty-minute drying time.

children.title: Hear the attendant
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: Washer four is in use. It will be free in ten minutes. The shop next door can give change, but it is closed today. You can leave your basket here while you wait.

questions.prompt: When will washer four be free?
questions.explanation: The attendant says it will be free in ten minutes.

questions.prompt: Can the shop give you change today?
questions.explanation: The shop next door is closed today.

children.title: Tell the attendant your plan
children.prompt_text: The attendant asks if you want to look for another shop or wait.
children.instructions: Say which machine you need and ask where you can leave the basket.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: I will wait for washer four because I have a card. Can I leave my basket by this chair for ten minutes?

children.title: Explain the wait to your friend
children.prompt_text: Your friend thinks you will be ready in thirty minutes. Tell them why you need an hour.
children.instructions: Include the wait, wash and dry times. Say how you will pay.
children.goal: Choose machines you can pay for and explain your plan.
children.model_answer: I need about one hour. I have to wait ten minutes for washer four. The wash takes thirty minutes and the dryer takes twenty minutes. I will pay by card. I can meet you outside after that.

points.label: Include both cycles
any: thirty minutes and the dryer takes twenty
30 minutes to wash and 20 to dry
